name: Yugi Muto
title: King of Games
tagline: Heart of the Cards & Master Tactician
description: A kind-hearted high school student who solved the ancient Millennium Puzzle. Yugi trusts completely in the Heart of the Cards and uses clever defensive and toolbox combos.

decks.name: Magnet & Gadget Arsenal
decks.description: Combines the magnetic force of Alpha, Beta, and Gamma with mechanical Gadget draw engines.

decks.name: Silent Swordsman Level-Up
decks.description: Patience and defensive fortresses power up the Silent Swordsman and Skilled Magicians.

decks.name: Exodia the Forbidden One
decks.description: Gather all five pieces of the Forbidden One while using impenetrable defenses and search spells.

name: Yami Yugi
title: Pharaoh Atem
description: The spirit of Pharaoh Atem residing within the Millennium Puzzle. Commands the ultimate Spellcaster monsters, the legendary Egyptian Gods, and heroic ritual warriors.

decks.name: Pharaoh's Dark Magic
decks.description: The ultimate wizard in terms of attack and defense, supported by Dark Magician Girl and Thousand Knives.

decks.name: Slifer the Sky Dragon
decks.description: Summon the heavenly dragon Slifer whose ATK surges with every card held in hand.

decks.name: Black Luster Soldier Chaos
decks.description: Harness the supreme power of Black Luster Soldier and Gaia The Fierce Knight to shatter the opposition.

name: Seto Kaiba
title: KaibaCorp President
description: The billionaire head of Kaiba Corporation and creator of Duel Disks. Relies on overwhelming dragon beatdown power and high-tech destructive strategies.

decks.name: Blue-Eyes Dragon Fury
decks.description: Unleashes three legendary Blue-Eyes White Dragons and fuses them into Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon.

decks.name: Obelisk the Tormentor
decks.description: Sacrifice two monsters to trigger the devastating Soul Energy Max effect of Obelisk the Tormentor.

decks.name: XYZ-Dragon Cannon Mech
decks.description: Assemble X-Head Cannon, Y-Dragon Head, and Z-Metal Tank into impenetrable mobile assault fortresses.

name: Joey Wheeler
title: The Godfather of Games
description: A fiercely loyal duelist who relies on guts, raw determination, warrior instincts, and high-risk luck cards that turn the tide in an instant.

decks.name: Red-Eyes Darkness Ferocity
decks.description: Channel the potential of Red-Eyes Black Dragon and evolve into Red-Eyes Darkness Dragon.

decks.name: Gambler's Fortune & Warriors
decks.description: Roll the dice and flip coins with Graceful Dice, Skull Dice, and Fairy Box.

decks.name: Jinzo Trap Annihilation
decks.description: Shut down all opponent traps completely with Jinzo while swarming with warriors.

name: Téa Gardner
title: Friendship Guardian
description: Yugi’s closest friend whose deck focuses on radiant fairy monsters, continuous Life Point recovery, and peaceful stalling spells.

decks.name: Shining Fairy Friendship
decks.description: Strengthen gentle fairy creatures with healing blessings and defensive warding.

decks.name: Maha Vailo Equip Power
decks.description: Equip Mage Power and United We Stand to turn Maha Vailo into an untouchable juggernaut.

decks.name: Fire Princess Burn & Sanctuary
decks.description: Deal direct effect damage to the opponent every time your Life Points are restored.

name: Tristan Taylor
title: Cybernetic Striker
description: A tough and reliable ally who commands military machines, tactical commanders, and steadfast earth warriors.

decks.name: Command Infantry Strike
decks.description: Commanding mechanical infantry with Battle Footballer and high-defense Cyber units.

decks.name: Battleguard Brothers War
decks.description: Lava Battleguard and Swamp Battleguard fight side-by-side to amplify each other’s strength.

decks.name: Robotic Heavy Siege
decks.description: Crush enemy lines with Cyber-Tech Alligator and Machine King boosted by Limiter Removal.

name: Mai Valentine
title: Queen of the Sky
description: A glamorous and independent master duelist whose Harpie Lady flock controls the field with swift aerial strikes.

decks.name: Harpie Lady Sky Flurry
decks.description: Swarm the skies with Harpie Lady 1, 2, 3 and summon the fearsome Harpie’s Pet Dragon.

decks.name: Amazoness Tribal Onslaught
decks.description: Amazoness Swords Woman and Amazoness Paladin turn opponent strength into self-destruction.

decks.name: Winged-Beast Tempest
decks.description: Harness the gusting winds with Birdface and Sonic Shooter to strike directly over defenses.

name: Bakura Ryou
title: Shadow Realm Wanderer
description: Possessed by the sinister spirit of the Millennium Ring, Bakura uses terrifying fiends, occult destiny boards, and deck destruction.

decks.name: Destiny Board of Doom
decks.description: Spell out F-I-N-A-L on the field to claim instant victory from the shadows.

decks.name: Undead Necromancy
decks.description: Command Vampire Lord and Ryu Kokki to continuously resurrect from the Graveyard.

decks.name: Fiendish Deck Destruction
decks.description: Force the opponent to discard and mill their entire deck with Morphing Jar and Needle Worm.

name: Marik Ishtar
title: Tomb Keeper of the Sun
tagline: Millennium Rod & The Winged Dragon of Ra
description: Leader of the Rare Hunters and wielder of the Millennium Rod. Binds his victims with sadistic burn damage and the golden sun god.

decks.name: The Winged Dragon of Ra
decks.description: Incinerate everything with The Winged Dragon of Ra while tributing opponent monsters for Lava Golem.

decks.name: Gravekeeper's Necrovalley
decks.description: Seal both Graveyards with Necrovalley while Gravekeeper monsters gain overwhelming attack.

decks.name: Torture Chamber Burn
decks.description: Inflict inescapable damage turn after turn with Bowganian and Wave-Motion Cannon.

name: Maximillion Pegasus
title: Creator of Duel Monsters
description: The flamboyant president of Industrial Illusions and creator of the card game. Bypasses defenses with whimsical cartoon Toons and eldritch illusions.

decks.name: Toon World Kingdom
decks.description: Enter Toon World to attack directly with Toon Dark Magician Girl, Toon Summoned Skull, and Toon Blue-Eyes.

decks.name: Relinquished Illusion Eyes
decks.description: Absorb enemy monsters and turn their attack power against them with Relinquished and Thousand-Eyes Restrict.

decks.name: Illusionist Mind Scan
decks.description: Confuse the opponent with Jigen Bakudan, Magical Hats, and mysterious spellcaster tricks.

name: Jaden Yuki
title: Slifer Red Champion
description: The carefree hero of Duel Academy who loves the thrill of dueling. Fuses Elemental HEROes and contacts Neo-Spacians with boundless enthusiasm.

decks.name: Elemental HERO Fusion Force
decks.description: Fuse Avian, Burstinatrix, Clayman, and Sparkman into Flame Wingman and Thunder Giant.

decks.name: Neos Space Contact
decks.description: Send Elemental HERO Neos into orbit to Contact Fuse with Neo-Spacians without Polymerization.

decks.name: Wildedge Bladedge Beatdown
decks.description: Pierce defenses and attack all monsters with Elemental HERO Bladedge and Wildedge.

name: Zane Truesdale
title: The Cyber Duelist (Hell Kaiser)
description: The top student at Duel Academy who masters Cyber Dragon fusions before descending into the underworld of Cyberdark dragons.

decks.name: Cyber Dragon Evolution
decks.description: Summon the twin-headed Cyber Twin Dragon and triple-headed Cyber End Dragon with Power Bond.

decks.name: Cyberdark Dragon Underworld
decks.description: Equip dragons from the Graveyard to Cyberdark Horn, Edge, and Keel to create the ultimate Cyberdark Dragon.

decks.name: Cybernetic OTK Overload
decks.description: Double attack power with Limiter Removal and Megamorph for an unstoppable single-turn victory.

name: Syrus Truesdale
title: Vehicroid Engineer
description: Zane’s younger brother who overcomes self-doubt through the power of cheerful and quirky Vehicroid machines.

decks.name: Super Vehicroid Connection
decks.description: Combine Gyroid, Steamroid, and Drillroid into Super Vehicroid Jumbo Drill.

decks.name: Ambulanceroid Rescue Corps
decks.description: Rescue fallen machine comrades with Ambulanceroid and Expressroid.

decks.name: Patroid Tactical Patrol
decks.description: Patrol the field with Truckroid and Stealthroid boosted by machine power.

name: Chazz Princeton
title: The Chazz (Manjyome Thunder)
tagline: Chazz It Up! Armed Dragons & Ojama Kings
description: The proud elite duelist who survived North Academy. Master of Armed Dragon evolutions, Ojama trios, and V-to-Z machine fusions.

decks.name: Armed Dragon Level Evolution
decks.description: Level up Armed Dragon from LV3 to LV5, LV7, and LV10 to wipe out all enemy monsters.

decks.name: Ojama Yellow Delta Hurricane
decks.description: Unite the goofy Ojama Yellow, Green, and Black to unleash Ojama Delta Hurricane and Ojama King.

decks.name: VWXYZ-Dragon Catapult Mech
decks.description: Combine V-Tiger Jet, W-Wing Catapult, and the XYZ mechs into the ultimate VWXYZ-Dragon Catapult Cannon.

name: Alexis Rhodes
title: Obelisk Blue Queen
tagline: Cyber Blader Martial Arts & Ice Queen
description: The top female duelist at Duel Academy. Combines graceful Cyber martial artist warriors with deadly ice and ballerina fusions.

decks.name: Cyber Blader Tutu Ballet
decks.description: Fuse Blade Skater and Etoile Cyber to summon Cyber Blader whose abilities scale with opponent monster count.

decks.name: Cyber Shadow Martial Defense
decks.description: Counter enemy attacks with Cyber Shadow Gardna, Cyber Raider, and The Fiend Megacyber.

decks.name: Abyss Soldier Ocean Strike
decks.description: Control the field with Abyss Soldier and A Legendary Ocean.

name: Bastion Misawa
title: The Analytical Duelist
description: A brilliant student who calculated six distinct element decks. Uses chemical bonding reactions to summon the colossal Water Dragon.

decks.name: Water Dragon Chemical Bonding
decks.description: Combine Hydrogeddon and Oxygeddon through Bonding H2O to materialize Water Dragon.

decks.name: Vorse Earth Formula
decks.description: A scientifically optimized high-ATK Earth beatdown deck with Vorse Raider and Gemini Elf.

decks.name: Magnet & Rock Control
decks.description: Calculate defensive walls with Magnet Warriors and Megarock Dragon.

name: Chumley Huffington
title: Outback Beast Master
description: A relaxed and creative duelist from Australia who loves grilled cheese and gentle Australian wildlife before becoming an Industrial Illusions card designer.

decks.name: Master of Oz Giant Koalas
decks.description: Fuse Big Koala and Des Kangaroo to summon the colossal 4200 ATK Master of Oz.

decks.name: Kangaroo Boxing Beatdown
decks.description: Overrun the opponent with Berserk Gorilla and Enraged Battle Ox dealing piercing damage.

decks.name: Outback Wilderness Survival
decks.description: Survive enemy assaults with Giant Rat and counterattack with furious beast surges.

name: Aster Phoenix
title: Destiny HERO Prodigy
tagline: Clock Tower Prison & Destiny End Dragoon
description: The genius pro league duelist who wields the dark mirror to Elemental HEROes: the philosophical and merciless Destiny HEROes.

decks.name: Destiny Clock Tower Prison
decks.description: Advance the clock counters on Clock Tower Prison to summon Destiny HERO - Dreadmaster and Plasma.

decks.name: Diamond Dude Spell-Turbo
decks.description: Activate powerful normal spells directly from the top of the deck with Destiny HERO - Diamond Dude.

decks.name: Destiny End Dragoon Assault
decks.description: Fuse Plasma and Dogma into Destiny End Dragoon to burn opponent Life Points every turn.

name: Jesse Anderson
title: Crystal Beast Sovereign
description: A warm-hearted transfer student from North Academy who speaks to the spirits of his seven Crystal Beasts and summons Rainbow Dragon.

decks.name: Rainbow Dragon Overdrive
decks.description: Gather all seven Crystal Beasts in the Spell & Trap Zones to summon the almighty 4000 ATK Rainbow Dragon.

decks.name: Crystal Pegasus Swarm
decks.description: Continuously search and swarm the field with Sapphire Pegasus and Ruby Carbuncle.

decks.name: Ancient City Rainbow Ruins
decks.description: Fortify your defenses with Ancient City - Rainbow Ruins unlocking up to 5 tiers of continuous effects.

name: Dr. Vellian Crowler
title: Department Chair of Obelisk Blue
description: The flamboyant yet formidable professor at Duel Academy who possesses a PhD in Dueling and commands unstoppable Ancient Gear siege engines.

decks.name: Ancient Gear Golem Siege
decks.description: Summon the legendary 3000 ATK Ancient Gear Golem that prevents all Spell and Trap activations during battle.

decks.name: Ultimate Ancient Gear Fusion
decks.description: Fuse three Ancient Gear titans into the devastating 4400 ATK Ultimate Ancient Gear Golem.

decks.name: Ancient Gear Cannon Lockdown
decks.description: Duplicate Ancient Gear Cannon with Machine Duplication to lock down and burn opponent lines.
